applies_as: uniform per-cell sink rate cap (Domain.drainage_capacity), converted to m/s; removed water booked as ledger.drainage
rationale: No primary drainage data: manifests/datasets.json lists drainage_capacity as MISSING (BCASA sewer capacities not publicly verified). Per docs/milestone2_plan.md M2-A1-05 and gate G4, any drainage sink must be an explicit ASSUMPTION scenario with a capacity sweep. Values follow the plan's example sweep (0/10/20/30 mm/h equivalent). They are NOT derived from any Barcelona network design standard and carry no external citation; they bracket the sensitivity of results to drainage only.
requires_signoff: Marc (gate G4) before any Barcelona run uses these

scenarios.name: none
scenarios.note: no drainage; upper bound on surface water
